## April 23, 2026

## RBI approves the voluntary amalgamation of The Mekhar Urban Co-op Bank

## Ltd., Mekhar with Nagpur Nagarik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Nagpur

||The Reserve Bank of India, in exercise of the powers conferred under sub-section|
|---|---|
||(4) of Section 44A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of The Mekhar Urban Co-op Bank Ltd., Mekhar with Nagpur Nagarik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Nagpur. The Scheme will come into effect from April 24, 2026 (Friday). All the branches of The Mekhar Urban Co-op Bank Ltd will function as branches of Nagpur Nagarik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Nagpur|
|with effect from April 24, 2026.||

## (Brij Raj)
